stops.title: The forms
stops.caption: Six, for the things people ask for.
stops.speech: Forms covers a first-time visit, baptism, a testimony, baby naming, baby dedication and the New Believers class.

stops.title: Filling one in
stops.caption: It reaches the right person.
stops.speech: Fill one in and it lands with whoever handles it, with the person linked to their record if they already have one.
